strings.en: All right, let's sort this out... Show Zama, hard as it is to believe...
you're saying you came from an entirely different world?
To be precise... I was pulled in from this world,
so that's how it really is.
I was born in Byston Well.
Then... Nyamhee is from a world other than ours...
I just can't see it...
Byston Well, was it? A world between the sea and the land...
It's a hard concept to grasp.
It's true! Show and I aren't lying, you know!
...Cham Huau, your very existence
proves that he's telling the truth.
Huh? What? What does that mean, Show?
...He means you're a rare sight.
A fairy... That's a first for me.
Fairy? I'm a Mi Ferario!
Whew. Such an unclear situation, with aliens and fairies...
And the kids on the Dangaioh team were psychics, was it?
...It's enough to drive me mad.
Commander Hazuki, there are Gundam Fighters too.
Whew... So there are.
...Oh. Commander Hazuki, a transmission.
From the Neo Japan Colony... Major Ulube Ishikawa.
Oh, good timing. Put him through.
Gil...
What's this, what's this? Mia, you're looking pretty down.
Is it about Gil Berg, Mia?
...Yes.
He sure is persistent. I heard he went after Dr. Tarsan too?
Never mind that, we gotta figure out what to do next.
Just playing defense forever ain't any fun, y'know?
Even if you say that...
Hey, what are you all talking about?
You're... from the Getter Team...
Yeah, I'm Ryoma Nagare. This is Hayato Jin, and Benkei Kuruma. Hi.
Still... those outfits of yours... You look like race queens.
Race queens? What's that?
You don't know...? Oh, wait, you're aliens, right?
Yes. Mia's from Earth, though... I'm from planet Ratesia.
I'm from a planet called Lilith.
I still haven't got my memories back. Well, I'm not from Earth, at least.
Still... you sure don't look like aliens.
P-Please don't stare at us like that...
I'm surprised too.
Before our memories came back, Dr. Tarsan told us we'd been created,
so I thought we were all the same...
Dr. Tarsan? Is he your boss?
The geezer who tried to sell us to space pirates as weapons.
...He built Dangaioh too, so I guess that makes him our boss.
Space pirates... and Dangaioh. Mind telling us more?
I'd like a handle on what we know about friend and foe.
Not at all. Where should I begin?
I'm interested in Getter Robo too. Please tell us about it.
For now, what I want to know is...
are all the people of planet Ratesia split personalities?
Huh?
Yeah, everyone thinks that.
Domon and the others joined the Gandor Team?
They said they were chasing something on your orders, Major?
I did order them to track down "that thing," but...
I see. So they've joined up with the Gandor Team...
What should we do with them?
Let's see... It may be dangerous for them on their own...
If you don't mind, could you put Domon and the others to use there?
Personally, I'd welcome the extra strength, but...
"That thing"... You mean the "DG," don't you?
Let me explain that...
Dr. Mikamura!?
It seems Rain is in your care over there.
The daughter I knew was just a child. She's grown up so much.
Time certainly flies... Anyway, it was about the DG.
Yes... What exactly is this DG?
Dr. Hazuki, are you familiar with the term "autonomous metal cells"?
If I recall... Dr. Kasshu was researching them...
That's right.
The ultimate Gundam, built with those autonomous metal cells: DG Cells.
That is... the Devil Gundam.
The Devil Gundam...
Though its original name was the Ultimate Gundam,
it was stolen by a certain man and became the Devil Gundam.
And the man who stole it?
Kyoji Kasshu, Domon's brother and Dr. Kasshu's son.
What did you say!?
And Neo Japan's government named Dr. Kasshu, who secretly built this
dangerous Gundam, an accomplice, and sentenced him to cryo-freezing.
Cryo-freezing...
We tried our best... but sparing him from death was all we could do...
Neo Japan told Domon that if he recovered the Devil Gundam,
they would release Dr. Kasshu.
So I gave Domon the Shining Gundam, prepared for the Gundam Fight,
and ordered him to recover the Devil Gundam.
...I had no idea Domon was in such a situation...
It's truly unfortunate...
I hear the fighting on the surface is even fiercer than in space.
Perhaps Domon and the rest could officially join the Gandor Team,
and the Gandor Team helped track the Devil Gundam as well...
Understood. We'll see what we can do here.
I see... Then I'll leave it to you.
Please take care of Rain and the others.
(The Devil Gundam... It certainly can't be left alone...
but something about Major Ulube's story bothers me...)
Hm...? Is that...? Hey, what's up, Princess? Staring out the window?
...You are... Sir Kabuto?
Heh, you can tell she was raised right.
Drop the "sir," though. Just Koji is fine.
...All right.
Oh yeah, too bad the ninja didn't pan out.
...Yes. At this rate, we cannot save the Shema system...
Don't look like that. It spoils that pretty face, y'know?
Point is, we just gotta smash this Za Boom Army or whatever, right?
...But it will not be so simple.
Sure it is. Getting greedy and coming after Earth too was their big mistake.
Beat 'em back, and we protect both Earth and your planet, Princess.
Sir Koji...
Mind you, for some reason Earth's
got a ton of folks besides Za Boom gunning for it too.
...Even seeing it like this... it truly is a beautiful planet.
Perhaps that is why they wish to make it their own.
Yeah. "How green was my land."
Did I tell you this before?
A friend of mine fighting up in space right now... no, a guy I respect, said it.
That this planet's ours to protect, and we can't ever forget that feeling.
"How green was my land"... And here I was, moping all alone.
Love for one's home world... that is something one must never forget.
Exactly.
No ninja, but we've got that helper robot Tobikage on our side,
so it's not over yet, Princess.
Koji! So this is where you were!
Hey, you're not done servicing the Mazinger yet!
Whoops. Later, Princess.
Yes, thank you so much... Sir Koji.
Princess Romina, so this is where you were.
Shaff...
Hey, Princess Romina, feeling better?
Too bad... no ninja after all.
...What is not there cannot be helped. More importantly, Joe, this is Earth.
Your home... You need not stay with us any longer, you know...?
Heh, can't do that now. Look at the state Earth's in.
It's my planet. I figure I'll fight with the Gandor Team for a while.
..."How green was my land"... isn't it?
Huh? What's that?
Oh, no, it's nothing.
Damn, if only there were a machine I could pilot too...
But Joe, we can't just keep borrowing
the Kurojishi and Houraiou forever, right?
Yeah, Big Brooo.
No, that is quite all right.
It was our fault the Za Boom Army came all the way to Earth,
so I intend to see this battle through to the end with you.
Then I guess I get to stick with you a while longer, Princess.
Why not leave the ship, Joe? I shall protect the princess.
You sure? I'm the only one who can pilot the Kurojishi, y'know.
Grr, we have no need of your strength...
Stop it, both of you! You are in the princess's presence!
Whew, it's like watching kids squabble...
Hmm, so this is the Shining Gundam... that one's beloved fighting Gundam.
Oh? Kyosuke? Interested in the Shining Gundam?
Yeah. I hear it has some special system...
The Emotion Energy System.
A system that turns feelings like anger or joy into energy...?
That's right. Only the Shining uses it so far, though.
So the Gundam that looks like it's wearing a sailor uniform is different?
My Nobel Gundam's different. Neo Sweden developed it.
Why is someone from Neo Sweden helping Domon and the others?
I heard you joined the Gandor Team
as a special participant from Neo Sweden?
Honestly, it's just me being selfish
'cause I wanna train with Domon~
Training...?
Domon and Allenby are taking part in this fight
partly as training.
Domon and me only got into these Gundams
for the Gundam Fight in the first place, y'know.
Yeah...
Training, huh. ...Oh yeah, I've been meaning to ask,
what the heck is this Gundam Fight thing anyway?
I wanna know too~
Is it some kind of event?
Without all this recent chaos, the colonies would've vied for autonomy
in a scheduled bout using Mobile Fighters,
a martial arts tournament.
Wow, you know a lot. Are you into martial arts, Kyosuke?
There's a fanatic close by.
Unlike mobile suits, Mobile Fighters relay the pilot's moves to the unit,
and feed the unit's condition back to the pilot.
They use what's called the Mobile Trace System.
That's why maintenance is such a pain.
Whoa, so damage to the machine gets passed on to the pilot too.
That's why martial artists like us get picked as pilots.
Oh, by the way, it surprised me when it came at a shout of "Gundaaam!"...
How does that even work?
Voice-activated autopilot?
"How," you ask... well...
...I don't know the details.
But Raideen, a legacy of ancient Mu, has never seen anything like
those bone-like foes... And above all, to the Great Demon Empire's goal,
I feel they hold the key...
Or perhaps their target is Raideen itself,
built with the super technology of ancient Mu.
So these mystery beings exist, but what they are, we haven't a clue.
Well, whatever the case. Given how overwhelming the enemy is,
it's easier for us to fight alongside the Gandor Team.
How about it, Commander?
Hey, Mister, that's no way to ask someone a favor.
I don't mind at all, Sakurano.
The subordinates I sent to space are far ruder.
...Understood. I'd like your help in this fight.
I'm the one asking you.
Yes. We look forward to working with you!
Now, next... Yuiry, would you call the Dangaioh Team?
Yes. ...Oh, Commander, a transmission.
From Captain Bright?
Finally got through. Hello, hello! Is my crew behaving itself?
You are... Dr. Tarsan?
Indeed. Hazuki, was it? I'd like a word with the Dangaioh Team...
Dangaioh Team, coming in.
What did you wanna talk about~?
Oh... Dr. Tarsan!?
What, you said you'd gotten into a fight,
so I figured you'd kicked the bucket.
How rude! I'm not about to kick the bucket that easily!
Oh yes, you lot, isn't it about time you came back?
What are you scheming, Doc?
I'm not scheming anything! You don't grasp how serious this is.
We've been put on the Bunker's wanted list!
...!! Dr. Tarsan, this Bunker... space pirates, was it?
Just what kind of organization are they?
You don't know!? ...Honestly, these planets out in the galactic sticks...
Please don't say that. We want all the enemy intel we can get.
We don't really know either. Doc, just tell us already.
...Pai? You... still haven't got your memory back?
...Then never mind. Ahem. Yes, the space pirates the Bunker are...
Brother, you called for me?
Ah, Aina. I told you I'd make you the test pilot...
for that machine.
Yes...
The prototype will be finished shortly...
So your dream will finally come true, Brother.
No, it's a dream no longer. I'll throw it into the front lines
and turn this war, this whole situation, on its head.
Not only the Federation...
I hear aliens and unidentified forces are deployed as well...
It doesn't matter... whatever comes, before that machine...
I... want to help you, Brother...
Yes, it's reassuring to have you with me...
Oh no. ...Brother, isn't it about time for your medicine?
Yes...
Lord Ginias.
What is it?
Word from Colonel Norris. Someone has stolen a mobile suit
from a facility near Jaburo and is fleeing.
They're in pursuit now... What are your orders?
Hmm. Tell him I leave it to him. ...No, wait... Aina.
Yes, Brother...?
...And so, they're an outrageous bunch.
I hear they've lately teamed up with a self-styled space crime syndicate...
The future's pitch-black, I tell you.
A space crime syndicate...? Captain Bright mentioned...
Doctor, if they're after you...
Are you gonna be okay, Doc~?
Don't talk like it's someone else's problem! You're targets too!
Just come back. Dangaioh's still not properly tuned.
You can't even use the Spiral Knuckle!
...Hey, can't you fix it so I don't go flying along with it...?
...Let's go. The Bunker is after us...
If we stay, we'll only cause trouble for everyone on the Gandor Team...
Yeah. Doc, we're coming back.
Oh, splendid, splendid! Then, Hazuki, until we meet again.
Commander Hazuki. We're... going.
...I'm sorry. In this situation, I can't even lend you a hand.
The thought's enough. Mia, let's go.
Okay.
It was pretty fun. See ya.
Thank you so much!
Whaaat! For real!? THE Domon Kasshu is over there?
Yeah. He's apparently chasing the Ultimate Gundam...
the Gundam now called the Devil Gundam.
Hey, could you get me his autograph? Actually, let me talk to him.
If I get the chance. ...Anyway, what did you want to talk about?
Oops! That's not what I called about today...
Say, Kyosuke, those bone-like things, and the plant-like ones...
haven't they shown up down there?
They're appearing in space too...
You too, huh... Somehow I'm the only one who hears their voices~
You too... Excellen?
So you hear them too, Kyosuke! Phew, I'm not the only one...
Why can only we hear them?
The only thing we have in common is that one thing, so...
Yeah, true... but I don't see why.
Right... and that girl seemed to know you, Kyosuke...
Girl? What are you talking about?
A red machine that showed up with the bone things...
From the voice, she sounded like a little girl...
She hasn't gone your way?
No. The bone things appeared, but I haven't seen any red machine...
I see... She said, "I'm going to see Kyosuke, I am."
Me? What does that mean?
I don't get it... What do we do, Kyosuke?
I haven't told anyone in Londo Bell yet...
Better keep quiet for now... It'd only cause needless confusion.
Right. So that's that. We're sortieing soon, so I'm hanging up.
Yeah.
If you get lonely, call me anytime. I'll be waiting.
(Excellen and me... what do we have to do with that enemy...?)
Hm? What's wrong?
...No, nothing. Maybe I imagined it. ...I'll tell you once I'm sure.
...Weird Kyosuke. Bye.
Yeah.
(...That voice... Maybe I imagined it... Hm? Lieutenant Amada?)
Nanbu? Get ready to sortie. We're heading out now!
Enemy attack!?
Yeah, a former Argama pilot who escaped a Jaburo facility
is being chased by Zeon.
Roger. ...Hm? Dangaioh's mechs are gone?
Oh, the Dangaioh Team took off a little while ago.
...Amazing they can pilot in outfits that look like swimsuits.
I'd rather not think those are pilot suits.
